newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed on rolling of shorts.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed on rolling of shorts.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled mixed in active volumes as players rolled short positions out of the nearby July contract into deferred months, traders said.
Traders said the July/September inverse widened on a perceived firm cash market for spring wheat and on a lack of farmer selling.

Nearby July spring wheat also drew support from USDA's weekly export sales report, which showed net sales of U.S. wheat at 531,600 tonnes. That was well above trade expectations of 100,000 to 200,000 tonnes.
MGE spring wheat settled 3-3/4 cents per bushel lower to one cent higher, with July up one cent at $3.83-3/4. New crop September was down one cent at $3.70.
Traders said Atwood-Peavey was a featured player, selling 800,000 July and one million Sept but buying 800,000 Sept. Atwood/Peavey also bear-spread 1.2 million Sept/July at 13 to 13-1/2 cents.
Traders estimated Thursday's spring wheat futures volume at 27.9 million bushels.
